name: Marmot PreCip rain jacket
summary: A PreCip-family rain shell for an outdoor weather layer. The exact generation, size and colour are unverified; Eco reference features are kept separate from claims about the selected listing.
description: An accessible rain layer helps you adjust to changing weather without unpacking the whole bag. Choose a shell that works over your intended clothing and check its hood and cuffs before leaving. The manufacturer reference below is PreCip Eco; this record does not assume that every PreCip generation uses the same fabric or construction. Confirm the actual garment label before relying on generation-specific details.
